caption: The drawing depicts a single pair of pants centrally positioned on a plain, off-white background. The pants are predominantly black with wide, vertical teal blue panels running down the front of each leg, bordered by a decorative, patterned edging in a golden-brown color. The waistband is teal blue with a triangular, patterned insert at the top center, featuring a design of red, white, and black. On the left side of the pants (right side from the viewer’s perspective), there is an open flap showing a red vertical strip bordered with small silver buttons and a panel with a black-and-white intricate pattern underneath. Several silver buttons also line the top of the pants and one button is visible on the right hip area, with a chain or fob hanging from it. The pants display a symmetrical composition with notable detailing and a mix of colors including black, teal blue, red, gold-brown, white, and silver.
title: Man's Trousers
